ValidationRule.description: Field Complete requires at least four closeout photos. Scoped to Home Builder WO record types. Spec Section 8.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(RecordType.DeveloperName="Production_Install",RecordType.DeveloperName="Finish_Job"), ISCHANGED(Status__c), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status__c,"Field Complete"),ISPICKVAL(Status__c,"Pending Closeout")), Closeout_Photo_Count__c < 4 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Field Complete needs at least four closeout photos.
